brands.d: British maker of the single-dose Niche Zero conical grinder designed by Martin Nicholson, launched 2017 via crowdfunding.
Seattle-area home-grinder specialist founded by Kyra Kennedy and Kyle Anderson, known for repairable parts; now part of Breville Group.
Florentine grinder maker from Aurelio Conti's 1920 workshop, today Conti Valerio; hand-assembled Mignon and commercial grinders.
Venice grinder and burr maker founded by Luigi Mazzer in 1948, designing and producing all components in-house.
San Francisco brand begun as a 2013 Kickstarter by Jake Miller; kettles, grinders and storage with a design focus.
Grinder brand behind the DF64 family of affordable 64 mm flat-burr single-dose grinders with swappable burr sets.
Australian maker formed by the merger of Helor and Option-O; its first product was the Lagom P64 single-dose grinder.
Bavarian hand-grinder brand registered in 2012 by roaster Bernd Braune; production began 2013, Nitro Blade burrs from 2016.
German hand-grinder brand of the Biernatek family, manufacturing in Reghin, Romania; rebuilt after a 2018 factory fire.
Taiwanese engineer-founded hand-grinder maker with J, K, X, Q and ZP6 lines spanning pour-over and espresso.
Shanghai company founded 2012 making hand grinders, scales and the Sculptor electric grinders; multiple design awards.
Kagoshima maker of stainless-bodied ceramic-burr hand grinders and tea grinders.
Tokyo heatproof-glass maker founded 1921 as Hiromu Sibata Works; V60 dripper, Skerton mill (2001) and drip scales.
Vince Fedele's company, maker of coffee refractometers and the precision filter baskets that became the upgrade standard.
Accessory brand known for spring-loaded tampers, WDT tools, distributors and naked portafilters at accessible prices.
Australian maker of machined tampers (Barista, Nexus) and precision baskets.
Maker of app-connected coffee scales; began developing the Pearl in 2013, later the espresso-sized Lunar.
Montana company founded on a backpacking trip; Airscape canisters, BruTrek travel mugs; bought by current owners in 2016.
Newcastle-based Australian-owned maker of milk pitchers, knock boxes and barista tools used in cafés worldwide.
